senses.gloss: זַוֵּיד, זַוִּוִד (cmp. זבד; = b. h. צוד) to endow, outfit, esp. for travelling.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Deuteronomy 15:14">Targ. Y. II, Deut. XV, 14</cite> (h. text <cite ref="E00720"><he>הַעֲנֵק</he></cite>).—

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 17a:11">Ab. Zar. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>זַוִּידוּ לה זוודתא</he> (editorial insertion; Ms. M. <he>טרחו</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) prepare her shrouds; <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 17a">R. Hash. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>זוידו</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>צביתו</he>).

senses.gloss: to provide one’s self for a journey, lay in provision.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Joshua 9:12">Targ. Josh. IX, 12</cite> (h. text <he>הִצְטַיַּד־</he>).

senses.gloss: to tie up bundles. Ib. 4 (h. text הצטיר, v. צוּר, צָרַר).
